fields.name: zebra-row-color
fields.label: Zebra Row Color
fields.description: Background color for even rows when zebra rows are enabled. Use hex color code (e.g., #F5F5F5, #FAFAFA).

fields.name: htmlContent
fields.label: HTML Content
fields.description: Insert your HTML code here (including scripts and iframes). Use the 'Code' or 'Source' button (<>) in the editor toolbar to paste raw HTML. HTML is injected without sanitization - only use trusted sources.

fields.name: display
fields.label: Display Style
fields.description: CSS display property for the container (default: block). Options: block, inline-block, flex, grid, none, etc.

fields.name: iata
fields.label: IATA Code
fields.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the destination (e.g., AXM for Armenia, BOG for Bogotá, MDE for Medellín)

fields.name: display
fields.label: Display Style
fields.description: CSS display property for the container (default: block)

fields.name: target-countries
fields.label: Target Countries (POS)
fields.description: Optional: Select target countries/POS. If empty, shows in all. Compared against 'selected-country' cookie (ISO-2 codes).

fields.name: target-languages
fields.label: Target Languages
fields.description: Optional: Select target languages. If empty, shows in all. Compared against 'selected-language' cookie.

fields.name: open-mode
fields.label: Open Mode
fields.description: Exclusive: opening an item closes others. Multiple: several items can be open simultaneously.

fields.name: default-open
fields.label: Default Open State
fields.description: Which items should be open when the page loads. Individual items can override with 'Accordion Default Open'.

fields.name: visibility-start-date
fields.label: Visibility Start Date
fields.description: Start date and time for visibility. Accordion hidden before this date. If left empty, shows immediately.

fields.name: visibility-end-date
fields.label: Visibility End Date
fields.description: End date and time for visibility. Accordion hidden after this date. If left empty, no end limit.

fields.name: accordion-default-open
fields.label: Accordion Default Open
fields.description: If true, this item will be open by default when the page loads. Overrides the 'Default Open State' setting for this specific item.
